title: CommandReceiptDocument
description: Server-only replay receipt stored at commandReceipts/{command}_{id}: a retried callable, trigger or webhook finds it and returns the original result instead of running again. Pure replay only; consent, money, safety and audit evidence keep their own collections. A receipt past expiresAt counts as absent. The collection's TTL policy on expiresAt was approved by the owner on 18 Nov 2026 after the legal hold was narrowed.
x-owner: every command that dedupes its retries (functions/src/shared/commandReceipts.ts)

command.description: The callable, trigger or webhook the receipt belongs to; the document id starts with it.

requestHash.description: SHA-256 of what the first request asked for; absent for trigger and webhook dedupe, which have no request to compare.

result.description: What a replay returns that live state cannot rebuild; at most 4096 bytes.

expiresAt.description: Expiry: seven days after a trigger runs, thirty after a request or webhook. Counts as absent once past; the TTL policy was approved by the owner on 18 Nov 2026 after the legal hold was narrowed.
